Sections.title: General Map and Report Review
Sections.subtitle: Florida baseline; apply data-related items to the work performed.

items.title: Purpose and Scope
items.statement: Identify the product type and intended purpose.

items.title: Horizontal Control and Accuracy
items.statement: State the horizontal datum and control; retain independent accuracy checks and methods.

items.title: Vertical Control and Accuracy
items.statement: For elevation data, state datum and control and document accuracy and verification methods.

items.title: Assumed Datum Control
items.statement: If using an assumed datum, distinguish it from published datums and provide reproducible control.

items.title: Dated Supporting Records
items.statement: Retain dated measurements and computations supporting the product.

items.title: Responsible Surveyor and Business
items.statement: Show responsible surveyor name/license and issuing business name, authorization number, and street/mailing addresses.

items.title: Acquisition and Revision Dates
items.statement: Identify the last acquisition date and subsequent graphic revision dates.

items.title: Signature and Seal Statement
items.statement: Include the required original-signature/seal validity statement unless electronically signed and sealed.

items.title: Map Orientation and Legend
items.statement: Show north, scale, defined survey abbreviations, and the bearing reference to an established monumented line.

items.title: Mapped Feature Responsibility
items.statement: Identify responsibility for mapped features and integration of others' work.

items.title: Final Delivery Review
items.statement: Confirm signed/sealed deliverables, sheet references, filenames, revision consistency, and contracted formats before release.

items.title: Survey Limits and Intended Use
items.statement: Confirm limits, off-site coverage, expected design use, feature list, and required accuracy against the agreed scope.

items.title: Benchmark Verification
items.statement: Recheck benchmark elevations and control ties; record units, datum realization, and any conversions.

items.title: Terrain Breaklines and Coverage
items.statement: Check sufficient observations at grade changes, ridges, swales, banks, walls, pavement edges, and other terrain breaks.

items.title: Drainage Features
items.statement: Review accessible structures, rims, inverts, pipe sizes/directions, and flow features within scope; identify inaccessible observations.

items.title: Improvements and Utilities
items.statement: Confirm scoped visible improvements and utility evidence; distinguish measured, supplied, and inferred locations.

items.title: Coverage Gaps
items.statement: Identify inaccessible areas, vegetation obstructions, omitted features, and limits of interpolation.

items.title: Surface Model Checks
items.statement: Inspect triangulation, breaklines, boundaries, spikes, voids, and unintended interpolation across walls or water.

items.title: Contours and Spot Elevations
items.statement: Verify contour interval, index labels, spot elevations, and consistency with independently checked observations.

items.title: Water Observations
items.statement: Label the observed water feature and observation date; distinguish an observed water edge from a resolved property boundary.

items.title: Boundary Context
items.statement: Identify the source and limitations of displayed boundary information; complete boundary review when a boundary survey is included.

items.title: Digital Surface Agreement
items.statement: Confirm CAD/surface exports agree with the map in coordinates, units, elevations, extent, and revisions.

items.title: Topographic Submission Criteria
items.statement: Check recipient-specific datum, contour interval, feature coverage, accuracy, and digital submission requirements.
